## Checklist Runner

The interactive executor for any Checklist field: thumb-sized rows, pass / fail / n/a, measure inputs with unit and tolerance (out of tolerance auto-fails and says by how much), a photo slot, text and signature items, progress and "required remaining".

It mutates the checklist's items in place (contained fields on the host card) and calls `onChange` so the host decides when to save. Completion maths is `checklistStats` — the SAME function Complete Work Order uses to refuse an incomplete order, so the runner can never say "done" when the command would say "not yet".

Generic: onboarding checklists, publish checklists and audit procedures can run through the same component — nothing in it names maintenance.
